newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan blue chips push up Casablanca bourse.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan blue chips push up Casablanca bourse.

text.p: The Casablanca bourse started the week on Monday higher, pushed up by the market blue chips ONA Group, Wafabank and Banque Commerciale du Maroc traders said.
The all-share index closed at 417.35 points, up 0.73 percent on the previous week.
BCM, the market's largest capitalisation, continued its upward trend to close at 720 dirhams, up 20 dirhams on Friday's session.
Bourse officials said no more than 700 shares of BCM changed hands on Monday.
"There is no new element to explain the stock's recent jump ...The demand for BCM stock remains high but there is no paper to be offered to investors, " a Casablanca-based market analyst said.
The same explanation was also valid for ONA Group, she said.
ONA, which holds stakes in more than 100 companies including BCM, gained three dirhams to close at 415 dirhams.
With its 2.3 billion market capitalisation, Wafabank, rose 13 dirhams to close at 466 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, one of the bourse blue chips, rose two dirhams to close at 402 dirhams.
Ciments de l'Oriental, one of the country's main cement plants, closed at 349 dirhams, up 11 dirhams on the previous session.
The bourse volume dropped to 32.4 million dirhams from 138.1 million last week.
